messages.subject: Fall Quarter Meeting Time
parts:
Greetings D-RUG-ers!

Our fall meeting times will be Thursdays from 1-3pm in Wickson 2124.  Potential presentation topics include JAGS/BUGS, Shiny, Rmarkdown and flexdashboards, R Notebooks, D3 interfacing with R, and any other ones that folks bring up during our meetings, which will start next week (September 22nd).

Thanks everyone who filled out the meeting time survey!  If you haven't gotten a chance, feel free to answer the last 2 questions at your leisure, we're always looking for input.


--
Myfanwy Johnston
Ph.D Candidate, UC Davis
Animal Behavior Graduate Group
Biotelemetry Laboratory
